snippet.title: A Long Long Night Mod - The Simpsons Hit And Run Full Mod Gameplay
snippet.description:
Bart is throwing the biggest party in Springfield! Drive around town like it's the 80's! Enjoy the Synthwave and get the party started!

Features

8 Story Missions
New Bonus Mission
3 New Street Races
New Test Drive Wager Race
New Collectibles
New Vehicles
Two difficulty modes - Normal and Hard
Partially Synthwave inspired map and HUD
Level-ution after completing Mission 3.
3 New Costumes

Developers

Thomas "Hipporeno" Donofri
Surreal Bot



Download link: https://forum.donutteam.com/forum/topic/4997-a-long-long-night 

═══════════  INFORMATION  ═══════════

 Top-level French runner with multiple World Records. I speedrun for the love of the game — and to keep improving every day.
Here, you'll find speedruns, funny highlights, glitches, and more from my favorite childhood game.
